gaps.explanation: Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds: Transfers in General Fund 8,900 + Golf Fund 92,210 (p6) = 101,110 = Total (p7). Detail: General Fund departments combining statement 'Transfers in' (Administrative) 43,900 (p19) + Golf 92,210 (p16) = 136,110. The departmental combining statement records transfers between General Fund departments gross: Park (25,000) and Cemetery (10,000) out (p20) to Administrative, 35,000, which the General Fund column nets (Administrative 43,900 = 35,000 from departments + 8,900 from the Fire Equipment Fund). 136,110 - 35,000 = 101,110. Both printed; no fix.

Statement: Transfers out General Fund (92,210) (p6) + Other Governmental Funds (8,900) (p7) = (101,110). Detail: General departments Administrative (92,210) + Park (25,000) + Cemetery (10,000) (pp19-20) + Fire Equipment (8,900) (p18) = (136,110). The 35,000 Park/Cemetery transfers go to the General Fund Administrative department (intra-fund, netted in the General Fund column: in 43,900 - out 127,210 = net (83,310) = statement General Fund net transfers (83,310), p6). Both printed; no fix.

pp10-11 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints five enterprise columns (p10 Electric, Water, Sewer; p11 Trash, Landfill); none is in detail[] (Internal Service Fund column not used). JSON receipts = Sales 4,866,535 + Occupation taxes 145,745 + Other revenue 106,232 + Interest income 140,888 + Grant income 48,144 + Loss on disposal (24,623) = 5,282,921. By column: Electric 2,964,022 + 116,856 + 87,282 + 103,532 - 24,623 = 3,247,069; Water 704,954 + 28,889 + 13,970 = 747,813; Sewer 479,833 + 2,490 = 482,323; Trash 201,025; Landfill 516,701 + 2,490 + 37,356 + 48,144 = 604,691. Sum 5,282,921 = statement total.
